setupDescription: Download the tools once to build Steam Deck games from this project.
errorHelp: The action could not be completed. Check your connection and try again. The cause is available in the details.
implementationPending: This feature is still in development and is unavailable in this build.
offline: Both backends are available offline after preparation.
profileHelp: Choose Steam Deck / Native or Steam Deck / Chromium in the project's build settings.
pairing: Pair the device using Valve's SteamOS Devkit Client before connecting.
sdkHelp: Select a local official SDK. Redistributables are imported into the project bundle; SDK paths and SSH settings stay in your studio profile.
cloudHelp: Relative save folder. Auto-Cloud configuration instructions are generated with the bundle.
downloadHelp: Tools are downloaded once into the shared DevLine cache and reused across projects. Both backends work offline after preparation.
hardwareHelp: Launch, sleep, audio and performance still need testing on a real Steam Deck. Preparing tools does not replace device testing.
identityHelp: Path to the private SSH key on this computer. It connects to Steam Deck and is not included in the exported game.
deviceHelp: Check the connection or transfer a build. Run on Deck builds and transfers the selected backend, then starts the game. Pair the device first.
monitorHelp: Shows only the game started by DevLine. Frames update about once a second while the panel is visible. Open the log when needed.
deckyPluginHelp: DevLine Test Runner ZIP. Copy it to Deck and use Decky Loader’s local ZIP installation. The plugin also ships in Studio’s tools/steamdeck folder. It lists DevLine builds and controls only DevLine games.
appIdHelp: Enter your game’s App ID. A test ID must be set explicitly for development.
developmentHelp: Mode for test runs. Publishing requires your own App ID; a test steam_appid.txt must not be included in a release.
settingsHelp: Connection settings and the SDK path are stored in your studio profile. They are not added to project files.
operationHelp: Operation stages also appear in the studio Output tab. The log includes download, verification and extraction details.
layoutError: Java or Chromium files were not found after extraction.
existingToolchainError: Installed tools are incomplete or changed. See the operation log.
checksumError: A downloaded file failed the integrity check.
downloadError: Could not download components. Check your connection and try again.
sshConnectionError: Could not connect over SSH. Check the address, port and SSH key.
configureFirst: Set up a connection in extension settings.
steamworksTaskHelp: Uses the SDK and App ID saved in Steam Deck settings.
settingsBusy: An operation is running. Refresh after it finishes to edit settings.
invalidHost: Enter a host name or IP address.
invalidUser: Use a lowercase SSH user name.
invalidAppId: Enter an App ID from 1 to 4294967295.
noDeviceBuilds: No test builds installed on Deck.
